sentiment: Even the last of a slow, old thing still moves — and moving deliberately is its own kind of grace.

stories.title: Europe's last regular standard-gauge steam passenger service
stories.summary: A scheduled steam train that never became a museum piece — still leaving on time, still carrying strangers on ordinary errands. The everyday made holy by sheer persistence.

stories.title: GUIs should be fully keyboard-driven
stories.summary: A quiet manifesto for deliberate interaction — each keystroke a considered step instead of a lazy default. Moving slowly on purpose is a discipline of its own.
